Actual Article Body:
Sen. John Kennedy (R-LA) sounded off on how senators use artificial intelligence on Tuesday, saying there is a version of ChatGPT specifically for the upper chamber.

“The Senate has a version of Chat[GPT]. It’s a special Senate version of ChatGPT,” Kennedy told TMZ DC on Monday.
